title: Projection commutes with fixing another coordinate
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $i$ and $j$ be distinct coordinates. Projecting $f$ onto all coordinates except $i$ and then fixing coordinate $j$ to a value $\omega\in\Omega$ gives the same function as first fixing coordinate $j$ to $\omega$ and then projecting onto all coordinates except $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
